candidates.change_summary: Replace the owner-only guard on withdrawAll by removing the onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll.
Change withdrawAll to withdraw zero instead of full balance, causing no Ether to be transferred.
Change withdrawAll to transfer balance to a hardcoded zero address instead of the caller (via withdraw), causing balance to be sent to address(0).
Tighten onlyOwner to require msg.sender equals address(0) instead of the stored owner, preventing the real owner from calling withdrawAll.
Replace transfer to send (returns bool) and ignore revert on failure, changing whether withdraw actually reverts or not.
Remove the require check so onlyOwner no longer restricts calls, allowing anyone to call withdraw and thus changing observable withdraw behavior.
Replace the external call using .call with a direct transfer to _target, which changes failure behavior and gas forwarding.
Change the low-level call to ignore the returned success flag (remove the revert on failure), so failed sends do not revert the transaction.
Invert the success check so the call reverts when it succeeds (logical flip), producing different behavior after successful sends.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), so non-owners can call sendMoney and change who can invoke it.
